entities.name: Jofridus
entities.description: Cathar father of Thraben Cathedral and secret Skirsdag cultist who was killed by Raben Amsel.

entities.name: Skirsdag
entities.description: Cult to which Jofridus secretly belonged.

entities.name: Raben Amsel
entities.description: Man saved and mentored by Jofridus who later killed him and donned the demonic yoke.

entities.name: Reika Eberhardt
entities.description: Victim murdered by Jofridus, later a demon-possessed form slain by Raben.

entities.name: Bloodletter
entities.description: Cursed blade used to kill Jofridus.

entities.name: Demonic yoke
entities.description: Yoke fused to Jofridus's flesh, donned by Raben.

events.summary: Jofridus saved Raben from execution and mentored him.
events.quote: Raben Amsel , whom he saved from execution and mentored

events.summary: Jofridus coldly murdered Reika Eberhardt and tried to corrupt Raben with promises of eternal life.
events.quote: his cold-blooded murder of Reika Eberhardt

events.summary: Raben confronted Jofridus in a cavern beneath Thraben Cathedral, slew a possessed Reika, and killed Jofridus with the Bloodletter.
events.quote: ultimately killed him with the cursed blade, the Bloodletter

events.summary: Raben donned the demonic yoke, embracing a cursed existence to pursue vengeance and justice.
events.quote: Raben donned the demonic yoke that had fused with Jofridus
